subject: MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use and reference-rights — redline coordination
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
To: Alyssa Parker <alyssa.parker@finnova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
Date: 2029-03-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use and reference-rights — redline coordination

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks for taking this through your side. Attached is our working redline to the MSA and the order form focusing on publicity, reference rights, and logo use. High level items we flagged:
- Publicity carveout for limited performance metrics (we added a 14-day approval window)
- Reference rights: customer may opt into public case study; Redwood needs prior written approval for quotes and logos
- Logo usage: client logos must be pulled from the approved brand pack and used only per guidelines; escrow of high-res assets requested for marketing usage

Can you confirm whether Finnova is okay with the 14-day review window for press quotes and the escrow arrangement for logos? If not, please highlight the specific language you prefer.

Next steps I propose:
1) Finnova markups back into the attached docx (redline)
2) Internal legal (Olga) + sales (Marissa) and I reconcile within 48 hours
3) Final sign-off and DocuSign routing for the order form

Attachments: redlines_msa_finnova_030429.docx

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.inference
+1 415-555-0199

From: Alyssa Parker <alyssa.parker@finnova.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samir Kaur <samir.kaur@finnova.com>, Finnova Legal <legal@finnova.com>
Date: 2029-03-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use and reference-rights — redline coordination

Jasmine,

Thanks for the redline. A few quick notes from our side after an initial pass:
- 14-day approval window seems reasonable, but legal wants a fall-back if we do not respond in time. They prefer a 21-day auto-approve for press statements and a 30-day for customer quotes.
- Regarding logo escrow: we are open to providing brand assets, but we cannot grant perpetual usage for promotional campaigns without a specific campaign approval step.
- We need a narrow confidentiality carveout for aggregate usage metrics (anonymous usage stats) used in press releases.

I attached our comments inline in the docx and a short PDF with suggested language for the order form publicity clause. Also looping Samir from procurement for any commercial constraints.

Attachment: orderform_pub_clause_suggestions.pdf

Best,
Alyssa Parker
Head of Strategic Partnerships\Finnova
alyssa.parker@finnova.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
To: Alyssa Parker <alyssa.parker@finnova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
Date: 2029-03-05T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use and reference-rights — redline coordination

Thanks Alyssa, this is helpful. Quick responses to the three points:
- Auto-approve window: We are comfortable with a 21-day auto-approve for press statements and 30-day for customer quotes. We will update the MSA language accordingly.
- Campaign-specific approvals: Agreed. We will add a clause that requires separate written campaign approval for promotional campaigns beyond standard case studies and press announcements.
- Aggregate metrics carveout: We will include a clause explicitly allowing use of anonymized, aggregate metrics in marketing materials and press releases.

Olga, Marissa: please see Finnova's suggested language in the attached PDF and the inline redlines. Can you review the updated language below and confirm if the legal team is comfortable so I can send a consolidated redline back to Finnova?

Proposed new order form clause (draft):
- Customer grants Redwood the limited right to request and use Customer logos and quotes for marketing, subject to a campaign-specific approval step for promotional campaigns.
- Written approval required for direct quotes; if Customer does not respond within 30 days, Customer will be deemed to have approved the quote for use in the specified context only.
- Redwood may use anonymized aggregate metrics without prior approval.
- High-res logo assets will be uploaded to a secure shared folder accessible to Redwood marketing; usage will follow the provided brand pack.

I can incorporate any additional legal edits and turn this into a final redline by EOD tomorrow.

Cheers,
Jasmine

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Alyssa Parker <alyssa.parker@finnova.com>
Date: 2029-03-05T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use and reference-rights — redline coordination

Jasmine, Marissa,

Thanks for the summary. I reviewed Finnova's suggestions. From a legal risk perspective I recommend the following adjustments before we agree to auto-approve timeouts:
- Limit deemed approval to a narrowly scoped context (the specific press release or quote text attached to the approval request). Do not include blanket deeming for unspecified future uses.
- Add a revocation window: Customer can revoke a previously granted quote approval within 7 days of publication, with Redwood agreeing to reasonable removal or correction steps where feasible.
- For logo escrow: require that usage beyond one year or for paid advertising obtain renewed written permission. That prevents perpetual grant issues.

I attached a redlined paragraph that implements these guardrails. If Finnova accepts, we can produce a clean MSA + order form and route for signature.

Attachment: redline_legal_guardrails_olga_030529.docx

Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.inference

Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use and reference-rights — redline coordination

Team,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Finnova legal reviewed Olga's guardrails and those look acceptable with one minor tweak: increase revocation window to 10 days for operational reasons. Otherwise we are aligned.

Samir: please confirm commercial ok on your end and if so we can proceed to a final clean MSA and the order form for signature later today.

I'll upload Finnova's approved brand pack to the shared folder once we finish the clean round.

Best,
Alyssa
